messages:
maria: Heads-up — at ~21:10 we saw a sudden sustained spike of cache misses for prefix keys from a handful of routes. Backend QPS jumped and a bunch of workers fell back to the slower matmul kernel, latency spiked.
devin: Is this the prefix key normalization rollout we did last night? :thinking:
aj: I was watching the warmup sampler earlier, seemed fine. Any logs / stack traces?
maria: Pasting a short excerpt from the proxy logs and runtime profiler output:
```
[2026-03-18T21:10:23Z] route=/chat/stream miss=197 qps=4200 backend_qps=4120 prefetched=12 fallback_kernel=matmul
[2026-03-18T21:10:24Z] worker-27 cpu=89% kv_miss=1e3 kernel_switch=matmul->int8_prepare
profile: avg_token_latency 240ms -> 820ms during window
```
jen-sre: That burst looks like a miss fanout — cache layer couldn't keep up and clients multiplexed to backends. Can we throttle the proxy fanout or disable prefill temporarily?
maria: I think the prefill/autowarm loop is amplified by the new mesh connection pooling change — requests trigger rewarm on partial misses and that fanout cascades.
ops: We just got alerts for increased error budget burn and SLO alarms in prod.
deploy-bot: roll/ops: disable prefilling config -> started (user=jen-sre) 2151234580
aj: Command used?
jen-sre: Ran:
```
infractl feature toggle --env prod --set runtime.prefill=false
```
infra-bot: feature toggle applied, prefilling disabled on 80% of edges, expected rollback in 10m if stable.
devin: After disabling prefill I'm still seeing higher-than-normal miss amplification in the cache proxy queue, might be leftover in-flight rewarm tasks. How long before backlog drains?
maria: Backlog estimate ~3-4m based on current drain rate. Profiling shows kernel fallback is expensive because batch sizes went down — batching heuristic collapsed when many clients retried individually.
aj: So two issues: (1) cache keying + rewarm policy causing thundering misses, (2) batching heuristic sensitivity to bursty single-request flows. Both need fixes.
jen-sre: Short term: keep prefill disabled, increase cache service concurrency for 5 mins, bump proxy fanout cap to 8 -> reduces backend amplification.
ops: Implemented proxy fanout cap change at 2151234620, monitoring.
maria: After fanout cap + prefill disable, tail latency improved: token-latency p95 dropped from 820ms -> 270ms in next 120s window. Still seeing ~10% higher CPU due to kernel fallback overhead.
devin: For followups: (a) add a reheating debounce on rewarm triggers (b) make batching heuristic prefer microbatches when kernel switch observed (c) audit the new mesh pooling change for miss path interactions.
aj: I'll open PRs for (a) and (b), and we should schedule a small perf run to repro at scale.
jen-sre: Filing an incident ticket with timeline & mitigation steps. Thanks all — keep channel updated if anything re-escalates. :thumbsup:
